semantic_roundtrip.remaining_semantic_delta: New policy-family specialization: four public proofs, zero new public definitions; two algebraic helpers, one finite guarantee and one derived one-sided family corollary. One printed Example2.32, not four new book results. A fixed exogenous deterministic policy p receives the whole finite past-loss/output history and current whole loss after the current output. The actual Nat.rec/Fin.snoc trajectory is projected from its actual selected support. No comparator is a policy input. Same-p/x1 prefix equality does not certify independence of externally chosen policy, initialization or rates, an executable finite-query oracle, or randomized-law/measurability guarantees. Played global-support membership on this same run is sufficient; no universal off-path OracleLaw, assumed norm/energy, one-step regret, stability or supplied regret bound. Feasible initialization and played labels/comparators in [0,1], prescribed T>=1 and eta=1/sqrt(T) remain explicit. D=G=1 derives the numerical constant one from the source O(sqrt(T)) assertion and equation2.1; it is not a verbatim numerical theorem. The average theorem fixes p,y,x1 and requires legal feedback for every positive-horizon run, each with its own eta_T=1/sqrt(T). It concludes only eventual signed-average upper control. It proves neither signed convergence to zero, absolute Big-O nor a common anytime trajectory. T=0 is outside finite tuning and only an irrelevant eventual exception. Canonical Example2.32 current publication migration, linearization/optimal-step/unit-analysis current migration, remaining Chapter1/2 maintext, nine OTHER Chapter1 origin/main contributor gaps and necessary appendices remain REQUIRED. Chapter2 mandatory total is incomplete; Chapters3-16 remain unenumerated. Whole Goal ACTIVE, no chapter/book completion or main/live update. Current CONTRACT/BODY accepted; FINAL pending. Distinct required automated actors, requested Astra/medium without runtime or external-human attestation.
